The sheet is an agent team step tracker, a twelve-step progress list, built in Claw Camp. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Step 1 · first agent"; "Step 6 · memory"; "Step 12 · team". One small solid black printed block behind the current step "Step 6 · memory", its text knocked out in white.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Monochrome only, gallery-quality print photography.
